dump_android_ui_hierarchy: dump the Android UI hierarchy via uiautomator2 or native adb fallback and parse nodes
filter_ui_nodes_by_keyword: filter Android UI nodes by keyword using the ui function with keyword parameter
get_clickable_ui_nodes: get only clickable Android UI nodes using ui with clickable_only parameter
tap_screen_coordinates: tap screen coordinates on connected Android device via adb input tap command
parse_xml_ui_string: parse Android UI XML hierarchy string into structured node list with bounds and properties
